payload.summary: Therapy NICE citations sit in the original uploaded-file source entry, so the catalogue may count them as part of the upload
payload.detail: NEXT: give later-added guideline citations their own source entry (or a provenance field) so src/lib/sources/repository-providers.ts and the provenance panel (src/components/therapy-compass/record/source-provenance.tsx) show each citation with its real origin, then regenerate the therapy index. Why: provenance should not imply the import contained the NICE text. Context: Qodo finding on PR #3398, merged without a fix; the record note does state the references were added on 2026-10-09. Owner: assistant. Confidence: medium (not reproduced on the live catalogue). Depends on: #NZ4X41.
